newsitem.title: NORWAY: Folketrygdfondet sells 4 mln Aker shares.
newsitem.headline: Folketrygdfondet sells 4 mln Aker shares.

text.p: Norwegian state pension fund Folketrygdfondet has sold four million A class shares in engineering and offshore group Aker ASA, Oslo Bourse said on Monday.
The shares were sold at 143 crowns a piece, a statement said.
Aker A shares traded at 145 crowns on Monday afternoon.

The selloff reduced Folketrygfondet's shareholding in Aker to 2.48 million A shares and 50,000 B shares. This corresponds to 6.2 percent of A shares, which carry voting rights, and 5.2 percent of total stock in the company.
Folketrygdfondet was the main opponent of the merger of Aker and fisheries-based investment group RGI. Aker shareholders voted overwhelmingly in favour of the merger last Thursday.
